gen_risks.description: Inaccurate or incomplete identity data due to inconsistent legacy databases may cause exclusion and duplicate records.
gen_risks.mitigation: Use biometric deduplication, phased fresh enrollment, continuous data validation and automated reconciliation to ensure data quality.
gen_risks.evidence: existing databases had inconsistent quality and data formats... risk of propagating these inaccuracies

gen_risks.description: Insufficient institutional capacity and governance for the new National Registry Agency (NRA) could delay operationalization.
gen_risks.mitigation: Define clear governance charter, recruit key staff, provide capacity‑building, and maintain IMSC oversight of NRA setup.
gen_risks.evidence: operationalization of the NRA will be essential... establishing governance agreements with programs and other actors

gen_risks.description: Vulnerable populations in remote/rural areas may be excluded from NPR and SR enrollment.
gen_risks.mitigation: Expand mobile units, satellite connectivity, targeted communication campaigns, and monitor enrollment gaps for corrective action.
gen_risks.evidence: mobile units and satellite connection equipment... facilitate the enrollment of people living in isolated areas... risk of exclusion

gen_risks.description: Error, fraud, and corruption (EFC) could undermine the integrity of the digital identification system.
gen_risks.mitigation: Implement an end‑to‑end EFC monitoring system, conduct regular audits, enforce access controls and staff training.
gen_risks.evidence: design and develop an end‑to‑end Error, Fraud, and Corruption (EFC) monitoring system

gen_risks.description: Delays in verification of Performance‑Based Conditions may postpone disbursements.
gen_risks.mitigation: Prepare verification reports early, establish clear protocols with the Independent Verification Agency, and build verification capacity.
gen_risks.evidence: decisions over compliance and disbursement against PBCs will be made by the World Bank based on verification reports produced by the Independent Verification Agency (IVA)

gen_risks.description: Reliance on Excel spreadsheets for financial reporting may cause quality and timeliness issues.
gen_risks.mitigation: Deploy dedicated financial reporting software, automate IFR generation, and train staff on new tools.
gen_risks.evidence: use of a spreadsheet “Excel” and data extracted from the national budget execution software may lead to challenges in quality and timeliness

gen_risks.description: Potential procurement delays for maintenance contracts could affect system upkeep.
gen_risks.mitigation: Follow the Project Operations Manual, use STEP for tracking, and maintain existing contract management procedures.
gen_risks.evidence: procurement risk for the project is currently assessed as Low... PMU is requested to elaborate and adopt the POM, including the procurement section

gen_risks.description: Improper disposal of electronic devices (mobile units, laptops) may generate e‑waste.
gen_risks.mitigation: Implement a robust e‑waste management procedure, adopt sustainable procurement, and run awareness campaigns on proper disposal.
gen_risks.evidence: risks associated with the use of electronic devices (such as mobile units) include the potential generation of e‑waste and its improper disposal

gen_risks.description: Out‑of‑date NPR data could limit rapid response to climate‑related shocks.
gen_risks.mitigation: Ensure real‑time data updates, integrate NPR with the Disaster Risk Management system, and schedule periodic data refreshes.
gen_risks.evidence: NPR will provide reliable information on the citizens’ residential location, improving the Government’s ability to identify and reach individuals... quickly during climate‑related shocks

gen_risks.description: Gender imbalance may persist if women’s specific barriers are not addressed.
gen_risks.mitigation: Conduct gender‑sensitive outreach, monitor female enrollment ratios, and adapt communication to address women’s barriers.
gen_risks.evidence: women’s enrollment is higher than men’s... some strata of the population... are wary of providing their information... risk of exclusion

gen_risks.description: Changes in data‑protection legislation could render the system non‑compliant.
gen_risks.mitigation: Maintain continuous legal monitoring, embed privacy‑by‑design, and update policies promptly to align with new regulations.
gen_risks.evidence: project will follow national regulations related to personal data protection (Law 09‑08) and incorporate best international practices

gen_risks.description: Duplication of budget lines (e.g., AMO‑TADAMON) may cause financial reporting errors.
gen_risks.mitigation: Create distinct budget codes, perform regular reconciliations, and include audit checks for overlapping expenditures.
gen_risks.evidence: risk of duplication or overlap due to the use of the same budget line “AMO‑TADAMON” to justify expenditure

gen_risks.description: Target of >60 % population coverage may not be met, reducing project impact.
gen_risks.mitigation: Track enrollment KPIs monthly, accelerate outreach where lagging, and allocate additional resources if needed.
gen_risks.evidence: NPR national rollout strategy aims to expand the system coverage to more than 60 percent of the total population

gen_risks.description: Integration challenges between MOSIP platform and existing MoI systems could delay rollout.
gen_risks.mitigation: Conduct thorough integration testing, adopt a phased deployment, and maintain a dedicated technical support team.
gen_risks.evidence: MOSIP (Modular Open‑Source Identity Platform) listed among abbreviations indicating platform use

gen_risks.description: Coordination delays among ministries within the Inter‑ministerial Steering Committee (IMSC) may slow decision‑making.
gen_risks.mitigation: Define clear terms of reference, schedule regular IMSC meetings, and establish escalation procedures for urgent matters.
gen_risks.evidence: IMSC... ensures consistency, validates proposals, monitors progress, assesses challenges, and takes measures for effective implementation

gt_risks.description: Stakeholder risk is assessed as Substantial. Given the complex nature of the operation and the involvement of multiple stakeholders in the implementation of the National Population Register (NPR) and the Social Registry (SR), the Project Management Unit (PMU) will need to put considerable effort into ensuring better coordination to achieve the PDO. The national rollout and the improvement of the NPR and the SR will need strong stakeholder engagement, including citizens concerned by social protection programs who are often poor and vulnerable.
gt_risks.mitigation: The communication strategy will continue to inform all stakeholders involved in project implementation and will capitalize on lessons learned from the first Identity and Targeting for Social Protection project (P155198). The PMU envisions improving the grievance mechanism at local and national levels and establishing a system to promote citizen engagement and transparency. The Inter-Ministerial Steering Committee is responsible for developing guidelines for the strategic policy for the envisaged reform and ensuring a link with the ongoing social protection reform. Technical work will also cover a process evaluation to identify challenges, propose remedies, and provide recommendations to enhance system implementation at central and local levels.
